query: Write interview questions to find out if customers would use our new AI report generator.
expected_behavior: Reframes around the decision and past behavior instead of 'Would you use...?'
Produces a guide with intro/consent, warm-up, past-behavior core questions, neutral probes, and wrap-up
Avoids leading or hypothetical questions and recommends 6-12 participants per segment with a behavioral screener
Recommends piloting the guide with one participant

query: We ran usability tests with 5 admins on the new permissions page. Here are my notes - can you synthesize them into findings?
expected_behavior: Separates observations from interpretations and clusters them into themes
States evidence as n/N with representative quotes, never percentages from 5 participants
Rates severity and confidence, lists limitations, and uses the report template

query: Design a survey to measure how satisfied enterprise customers are with our onboarding.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/methods.md and ties each question to a research question
Uses balanced, labelled scales, single-concept questions, and behavior-frequency wording
States a target sample size with margin of error and expected B2B response rate
Includes consent/privacy handling and a pilot step
